baseline.sourceArchiveWorkingTreeNote: ZIP extraction produced broad line-ending/status noise; audit was performed from git archive of the committed HEAD object.

scope: Audit only. No runtime, registry, state, hash, review, approval, or publication changes.
findings: Four-volume Book Registry, Part Registry, Blueprint Registry, four Blueprints, v2 schema, and universal loader foundation are present.
The repository is in a mixed v1/v2 state: several current or compatibility consumers still reference a single Book I Blueprint directly.
Part 5 current publication ownership is BOOK-2, while legacy KN-B1-P5 identities and Book I manuscript-source records remain widespread.
PJA already has registry-loader integration in core libraries, but compatibility checkers and generated editorial records retain Book I paths.
KNR public/browser consumption is not fully registry-led because free-explore.js directly loads the Book I Blueprint.
Existing checker inventory must be classified before archive or replacement; historical evidence must not be deleted.
Generated projections can be rebuilt, but Human Review, Approval, Canonical Thesis, frozen assessments, and Published Articles are immutable.
